cues: Transition metals are superb catalysts, for two reasons.
Persulphate and iodide are both negative ions, so they repel and react slowly.
It oxidises iodide to iodine, becoming iron two plus.
Then persulphate oxidises it back to iron three plus.
The iron goes round and round, and is not used up.
text: Transition metals are superb catalysts, for two reasons. First, variable oxidation states. Persulphate and iodide are both negative ions, so they repel and react slowly. Add iron three plus. It oxidises iodide to iodine, becoming iron two plus. Then persulphate oxidises it back to iron three plus. The iron goes round and round, and is not used up.
